definitions.gloss: staring intently; gazing fixedly without looking away
definitions.explanation: Describes looking hard and steadily at something, usually out of surprise, doubt, or fascination. Nearly always used with と before a verb of seeing, and implies the looker forgets to be discreet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まじまじ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}つめて→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧、⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦{確|たし}かめた→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧。
examples.english: I gazed hard at the photo to make sure it was really him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渡|わた}された→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まじまじ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧まま、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}わなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: She kept staring at the letter she had been handed and said nothing for a while.

notes:
USAGE:
Combines almost exclusively with ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧, ⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧, and ⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧. The ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ is standard and dropping it sounds unnatural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- まじまじ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to stare at
- まじまじ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to gaze fixedly at
- まじまじ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look someone full in the face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦じろじろ→じろじろ：06907_jirojiro⟧: staring rudely up and down — the looker is being impolite, and the person looked at feels it
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧: steadily, without moving — calm concentration rather than surprise
